names.official: Personal income tax on income from dependent activity and functional benefits
names.native: Daň z príjmov fyzických osôb zo závislej činnosti

taxes.base: Wages, salaries and other income from dependent activity.

rate.headline: 19% and 25% in 2024
details: 2024: 19% on the tax base up to 176.8 times the subsistence level and 25% above. PwC reports EUR 48,441 as the threshold for 2025, and two further rates of 30% and 35% from 2026.
As summarised by PwC (review of 9 September 2026), not checked against the Financial Administration.

instruments.explanation: The largest direct tax on persons.

names.official: Personal income tax on business and other independent gainful activities
names.native: Daň z príjmov fyzických osôb z podnikania a inej samostatnej zárobkovej činnosti

taxes.base: Business and other independent income of individuals.

rate.headline: Same rates as employment income
details: As summarised by PwC (review of 9 September 2026), not checked against the Financial Administration.

instruments.explanation: EUR 194 million in 2024, against EUR 144 million in 2023.

names.official: Corporate income tax (resident legal persons)
names.native: Daň z príjmov právnických osôb

taxes.base: Profit of companies and other legal persons.

rate.headline: 21% standard in 2024
details: The standard CIT rate for 2024 was 21%. From 2025: 10% up to EUR 100,000 of taxable income, 21% from EUR 100,000 to EUR 5 million, and a higher rate above (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 9 September 2026), not checked against the Financial Administration.

names.official: Special levy in regulated industries and the solidarity contribution
names.native: Osobitný odvod v regulovaných odvetviach; solidárny príspevok

taxes.base: As named in the National Tax List: a special levy for regulated industries (EUR 533.6 million) and a solidarity contribution (EUR 55.7 million, a new line in 2024); the list gives no further detail.

instruments.explanation: The special levy rose from EUR 135 million in 2023 to EUR 534 million in 2024.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D51B C03 and C04

names.official: Withholding income tax (dividends, profit, interest and others)
names.native: Dane z príjmov vyberané zrážkou

taxes.base: Dividends, profit shares, interest and similar income. The list splits it into EUR 72.5 million withheld from individuals and EUR 456.6 million from legal persons, which together make the line used here.

names.official: Employers’ actual social contributions
names.native: Skutočné sociálne príspevky zamestnávateľov

taxes.base: Gross pay. The list splits it into pension (EUR 5,251 million) and non-pension (EUR 6,818 million) contributions.

rate.headline: Set by the social insurance laws
details: The rates are not extracted here.

instruments.explanation: The largest line of the whole list after VAT.

names.official: Compulsory social contributions of employees
names.native: Obvezné sociálne príspevky zamestnancov

taxes.base: Gross pay.

rate.headline: Set by the social insurance laws
details: The rates are not extracted here.

names.official: Compulsory contributions of the non-employed and of the self-employed
names.native: Obvezné príspevky neaktívnych osôb a samostatne zárobkovo činných

taxes.base: As labelled in the National Tax List: contributions of the non-employed (EUR 3,822 million) and of the self-employed (EUR 0.8 million). The list does not say who pays the non-employed contributions.

rate.headline: Set by the social insurance laws

names.official: Value added tax
names.native: Daň z pridanej hodnoty

taxes.base: Goods and services supplied in Slovakia and imports.
taxes.payer: Consumers; businesses charge it and claim input credits.

rate.headline: 20% standard in 2024; 23% from 2025
details: The basic rate was 20% until 31 December 2024, with a reduced rate of 10%; from 1 January 2025 the basic rate is 23% and the reduced rates are 19% and 5% (PwC).
As summarised by PwC (review of 9 September 2026), not checked against the Financial Administration.

names.official: Import duty and levies on imported agricultural products
names.native: Dovozné clo

taxes.base: Goods imported from outside the EU, by the Common Customs Tariff.

rate.headline: EU Common Customs Tariff
details: An EU own resource; Eurostat records it under the EU institutions.

names.official: Excise duty on mineral oils
names.native: Spotrebná daň z minerálnych olejov

taxes.base: Petrol, diesel, heating oil and other mineral oils, by quantity.
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on at the pump.

names.official: Excise duty on tobacco and tobacco products
names.native: Spotrebná daň z tabaku a tabakových výrobkov

taxes.base: Cigarettes and other tobacco products.
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

names.official: Excise duty on spirits, beer and wine
names.native: Spotrebná daň z liehu, piva a vína

taxes.base: Spirits (EUR 232 million), beer (EUR 56 million) and wine (EUR 5 million).
taxes.payer: Producers and importers; passed on in the price.

rate.headline: Per litre of alcohol or product

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D214A C02 to C04

names.official: Excise taxes on electricity, coal and natural gas
names.native: Spotrebné dane z elektriny, uhlia a zemného plynu

taxes.base: Electricity (EUR 12.8 million), coal (EUR 0.2 million) and natural gas (EUR 21.1 million).
taxes.payer: Suppliers; passed on in the price.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D214A C06 to C08

names.official: Green energy
names.native: Zelená energia

taxes.base: As named in the National Tax List ("green energy"); the list gives no further detail.

rate.headline: Not given in the list
details: EUR 183.6 million in 2024, down from EUR 420.8 million in 2023.

instruments.explanation: Booked by the statisticians among the excises.

names.official: Income from lotteries and similar games
names.native: Príjmy z výťažkov lotérií a iných podobných hier

taxes.base: Takings of lotteries and similar games.

names.official: Insurance tax and the levy on non-life insurance premiums
names.native: Daň z poistenia; odvod časti poistného

taxes.base: Insurance premiums (EUR 111.9 million) and a part of non-life premiums (EUR 39.2 million).

names.official: Road tax (domestic vehicles) and the car registration fee
names.native: Cestná daň; poplatok za registráciu automobilov

taxes.base: Road tax on vehicles used for business (EUR 140.3 million) and the fee for registering cars (EUR 59.6 million).

instruments.explanation: Eurostat books both under central government.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D29B C01, D214D C01

names.official: Water and air pollution fees, nuclear installation charges, excavation area tax, gas storage and emergency oil stock fees
names.native: Poplatky za znečisťovanie; daň za umiestnenie jadrového zariadenia

taxes.base: Water pollution (EUR 8.6 million), air pollution (EUR 10.0 million), siting nuclear equipment (EUR 3.9 million), excavation areas, gas and liquid storage, the emergency oil stock fee, and the electricity consumption tax for decommissioning nuclear facilities.

rate.headline: Set by law
details: The sale of emission permits (EUR 606.4 million) is not counted.

instruments.explanation: Seven lines, together under 1% of the total.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D29F C02 and C03, D29E C01 to C03, D214H C05 and C06

names.official: Administrative fees, licence fees and TV and radio licence fees
names.native: Administratívne poplatky; koncesionárske poplatky

taxes.base: Administrative fees paid by legal persons (EUR 127.6 million) and by individuals (EUR 53.3 million), licence fees, and the TV and radio licence fees, which fell from EUR 44.6 million in 2023 to EUR 2.1 million in 2024.

rate.headline: Set by law
details: Eurostat books EUR 57 million of the "other taxes on production" with local government; the list does not say which lines.

instruments.explanation: Six lines that the list codes as taxes.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D29E C06 to C08, D59D C06 to C08

names.official: Deposit protection tax, levy on excessive profit and other small taxes
names.native: Daň na ochranu vkladov; odvod z nadmerných príjmov; iné dane
names.common: Deposit insurance, windfall levy and other small taxes

taxes.base: The tax connected to deposit insurance (EUR 8.3 million), the levy on excessive profit (EUR 7.5 million, EUR 37.6 million in 2023), other taxes (EUR 0.9 million), other taxes on products (EUR 3.5 million) and a transfer tax on real estate of legal persons (EUR 0.01 million); the resolution fund line is zero in 2024.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D29H C06, C08, C09, D214H C07, D214L C01, D214C C01

names.official: Real estate tax on land, buildings and dwellings (companies and households)
names.native: Daň z nehnuteľností (z pozemkov, zo stavieb, z bytov)

taxes.base: Land, buildings and dwellings; the list separates the tax paid by legal persons (land EUR 86.7 million, buildings EUR 433.8 million, dwellings EUR 51.2 million) from households (land EUR 42.7 million, dwellings EUR 4.4 million).

rate.headline: Set by each municipality within limits
details: The list does not give rates.

instruments.explanation: The main tax of the municipalities in the list; buildings bring in most of it.

legalRefs.locator: sheet SK, D29A C01 to C03, D59A

names.official: Taxes on public space, dogs, gaming and vending machines, accommodation, entry to historic centres, and the local development fee
names.native: Miestne dane a poplatky

taxes.base: Use of public space (EUR 15.2 million), the local fee for development (EUR 39.0 million), dogs (EUR 5.5 million), gaming machines, vending machines, accommodation in recreational facilities, and permits to enter historic city districts with a motor vehicle.

rate.headline: Set by each municipality
details: Eurostat books EUR 693 million of taxes on production and EUR 47 million of wealth taxes with local government; the lines here and in the property tax come to a little less.
